#!/bin/bash
set -e
unset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY XAUTHORITY
loaded=()
cleanup() { local i; for ((i=${#loaded[@]}-1; i>=0; i--)); do launchctl remove "${loaded[$i]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; }
trap cleanup EXIT
launchctl remove com.apple.FileCoordination >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
launchctl load /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/linuxcode-cli/20261027T101627-c9af4f68/service-0.plist
loaded+=(com.apple.cfprefsd.xpc.daemon)
launchctl load /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/linuxcode-cli/20261027T101627-c9af4f68/service-1.plist
loaded+=(com.apple.FileCoordination)
launchctl load /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/linuxcode-cli/20261027T101627-c9af4f68/service-2.plist
loaded+=(com.apple.configd)
launchctl load /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/linuxcode-cli/20261027T101627-c9af4f68/service-3.plist
loaded+=(com.apple.diskarbitrationd)
launchctl load /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/linuxcode-cli/20261027T101627-c9af4f68/service-4.plist
loaded+=(com.apple.coreservicesd)
launchctl load /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/linuxcode-cli/20261027T101627-c9af4f68/service-5.plist
loaded+=(com.apple.bsd.dirhelper)
launchctl load /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/linuxcode-cli/20261027T101627-c9af4f68/service-6.plist
loaded+=(com.apple.lsd)
launchctl list com.apple.cfprefsd.xpc.daemon
launchctl list com.apple.FileCoordination
launchctl list com.apple.configd
launchctl list com.apple.diskarbitrationd
launchctl list com.apple.coreservicesd
launchctl list com.apple.bsd.dirhelper
launchctl list com.apple.lsd
printf 'LINUXCODE_SERVICES_LOADED\n'
/Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/artifacts/uniform-type-identifiers-native
printf 'LINUXCODE_UTI_PREFLIGHT_OK\n'
/bin/bash /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/unity-recvfrom-dd76-v1/prebuild.sh
cd /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/unity-ios-cocoapods-ios26-v1/ios
set +e
/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/usr/bin/xcodebuild "$@"
status=$?
printf "LINUXCODE_NATIVE_XCODE_STATUS %s\n" "$status"
exit "$status"
